author: NorthEast News Desk
body: A second suspect has been charged with murder in the Taunton shooting that killed one person and injured seven others at a large house party, prosecutors said Thursday.

Malkiah Cunningham, 25, of New Bedford faces one murder count and seven counts of armed assault with intent to murder. Sienna Barboza, 25, had previously been charged with the same offenses. The charges are allegations, and both defendants are presumed innocent unless proven guilty.

Police were called to 261 Weir Street at about 12:37 a.m. Sunday after gunfire erupted at a gathering that prosecutors said drew as many as 60 people. The victims were adults in their 20s. Zirovick Depina, 22, of Brockton, died from his injuries.

Prosecutors allege that Barboza drove an SUV to the scene and that Cunningham and another person, who had not been publicly identified in the source report, got out and fired toward the party. The investigation remains active as authorities work to identify all participants and establish the sequence of events.
dek: Prosecutors charged a New Bedford man in the shooting that killed 22-year-old Zirovick Depina and wounded seven other people.
headline: Second suspect charged with murder in Taunton party shooting
